data.why: The model shows a $28.7k expected profit lift versus doing nothing, with a 100% chance of beating the status quo. The gain comes from higher price and lower holding cost, while volume dip is modest. Cash stays positive with payback by week 9.
data.watch_out: If the assumed GPU cost surge does not materialize, the price hike could shrink sales more than forecast, leaving extra inventory and tighter cash.
data.recheck_when: Review when real supplier cost quotes arrive or at the week-9 payback mark.
